senses.gloss: (mostly corrupt) used, in connection with <he>לוקיוס</he> (Lucius), to represent gentile names in general.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> (ed. Fr. p. 107ᵃ; 107ᵇ) <he>ג׳ מן הגודר ולוקיוס מן וכ׳</he> e.g. Gaius of Gadara and Lucius of Susitha (Hippos). Ib. 108ᵃ (corr. acc.).—Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵇ top <he>גוים לוקין וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) G. a. L. are the signers and ye ask yet (whether the signers must be personally known as Jews to the witnesses)? [Bab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:5:6">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite>; Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵃ [ref. to letters accompanying a ship load (?)].
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:13:3">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> top (<cite ref="C00393"><he>גוליקוס</he></cite>) <he>גייס גוליקם</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Sotah 33a:8">Sot. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>גסקלגס</he>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite> <he>גיוסלוקין</he> (corr. <he>גיוס קליגולס</he> = Καλιγούλας).
